description: Call any VSP 360 REST API operation by operationId. Authentication is handled automatically. Pass path, query and header parameters by name in `params`, and the JSON request body in `body`. Collections are paginated with limit/offset (max 100 per page); set all_pages to follow the `next` link. Binary responses (ZIP, gzip, CSV downloads) are saved to the download folder and the file path is returned. Only read operations are allowed; the server runs read-only.

all_pages.description: Follow RFC 8288 `next` links and return every page (GET collections only).

body.description: Request body (JSON object or array) for POST/PUT/PATCH operations. For multipart uploads, the non-file form fields.

files.description: Multipart uploads only: form field name -> local file path

max_pages.description: Page cap when all_pages is set (default 20).

params.description: Path, query and header parameters by name, e.g. {"id": "123", "limit": 100}

save_to.description: Write the response to this file instead of returning it: a file name, or a path inside the download folder. Existing files are not overwritten.

name: vsp360_call_operation
